scope: Restore public agent-owned contract exports without assigning ambiguous flat metadata to the wrong agent
holdout: All exports of each of four contract modules must be available through the corresponding named namespace, with exact object/function identity
anchors: All five modules' existing unambiguous runtime exports retain ownership; shared flat names remain absent; every original passing Vitest test retained
gates: Full Node build/type/lint/format/coverage and security plus real locked Rust test/build/Clippy/fmt must pass; errors, timeouts and lost passing tests fail closed
architecture: No contract owner implementation, agent persistence, Rust source, IAM/GCP deployment or database change
metricLimitations: Primary is native namespace correctness, not model performance; noopRate is failed-contract ratio; costPerWin is unmeasured neutral zero
